strategies.name: Possession-adjusted game total
strategies.signal: Compare a pregame predictive total distribution from team pace and points per possession with a timestamped offered total.
strategies.inputs: Team pace, offensive/defensive rating, matchup and executable total odds
strategies.note: Model proposal, not an NBA-endorsed strategy; no odds feed, backtest or calibration.

strategies.name: Four-factor spread model
strategies.signal: Project margin from opponent-adjusted possession efficiency; test incremental value over a no-signal baseline.
strategies.inputs: Team efficiency, eFG%, turnover and rebound rates, schedule, spread odds
strategies.note: No source-verified as-of snapshots or market prices; no published pick.

strategies.name: Minutes-aware points prop
strategies.signal: Model player minutes and scoring opportunities separately; skip unresolved availability.
strategies.inputs: Player points/minutes, usage, injury timestamp and points-prop odds
strategies.note: Minutes and usage may depend on late lineup news; unvalidated.

strategies.name: Rebound opportunity prop
strategies.signal: Estimate player rebounds conditional on minutes and available misses, then compare to market.
strategies.inputs: Rebounds, minutes, lineup, team pace and rebound-prop odds
strategies.note: No verified market or distribution; do not substitute rebound averages for a probability.

strategies.name: Cross-game singles bundle
strategies.signal: Combine only separately qualified legs; test residual dependence rather than assuming independent games.
strategies.inputs: Qualified leg probabilities, joint outcomes, quoted parlay payout
strategies.note: Cross-game independence is not established; no quoted payout or joint-history sample.

strategies.name: Same-game total and side
strategies.signal: Estimate joint outcomes of total and spread in one simulation; compare to quoted same-game price.
strategies.inputs: Game-level joint outcomes, spread/total settlement rules and same-game price
strategies.note: Do not multiply marginal probabilities; joint dependence has not been measured.

strategies.name: Points plus assists
strategies.signal: Model joint points/assists distribution through shared minutes and usage, not separate marginal hit rates.
strategies.inputs: Points, assists, minutes, usage, combo market payout
strategies.note: NBA FAQ says combined PTS+REB+AST statistic unavailable on its site; combination data must be derived only with permission.

strategies.name: Teammate points and rebounds
strategies.signal: Simulate co-play time and shared possession environment for a two-player prop combination.
strategies.inputs: Player box scores, lineup overlap, injury status, joint payout
strategies.note: Same-game dependence, substitution and overlap cannot be assumed away.

gates.requirement: Document permission for automated data use; link each observation to an official origin and capture as-of time.
gates.failure: No lawful programmatic source or missing provenance → no run.

gates.requirement: Freeze predictions before market close; use only observations published before that cutoff.
Recheck timestamped injury status and match exact operator market/void rules before any prop comparison.
gates.failure: Unresolved status or missing rules → abstain.

gates.requirement: Store offered odds, line, operator, timestamp, limits and exact market definition; calculate break-even after applicable costs.
gates.failure: Missing executable quote or rules → abstain.

gates.requirement: On chronological holdouts, compare predicted probability bins to observed rates; report proper scoring loss and uncertainty.
gates.failure: No out-of-sample results or unstable calibration → research only.

gates.requirement: Benchmark against market-implied probabilities after removing vig, simple baseline and pre-registered ablations.
gates.failure: No demonstrated incremental out-of-sample benefit → research only.

gates.requirement: Estimate joint outcomes on matched historical samples with confidence intervals; stress correlation by regime.
gates.failure: Missing joint sample, CI or sensitivity test → no combo/parlay.

gates.requirement: Log every candidate and abstention before outcomes; score on a fixed chronological test set with identical market access.
gates.failure: Selective reporting, leakage or tiny samples → no rank.

gates.requirement: Cap exposure, test drawdown and treat financial risk as real; never imply guaranteed return.
gates.failure: Unbounded loss or unsupported income claim → reject.

correlations.method: Pearson on numeric outcomes and conditional simulation; check shared-score overlap.
Phi coefficient for binary settles, stratified by line and period.
Pearson/Spearman on continuous counts; phi for threshold events; account for shared minutes.
Paired joint outcomes with lineup/minutes conditioning and bootstrap by game.

correlations.pair: Leg A hit ↔ leg B hit (cross-game)
correlations.method: Phi coefficient; assess common schedule and market-regime factors.
